description: This file defines the DeleteNoteCommandHandler class responsible for handling delete note commands in the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the delete operation to the NoteWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteNoteCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles delete note commands, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and using NoteWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

methods.name: DeleteNoteCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the NoteWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking deleteNote on the writePlatformService with the provided JsonCommand.
